efficacy.judgement: Scored unsettled, not contra: seletalisib was terminated at 36% power with a favourable trend, and leniolisib's 29-patient CIs span both benefit and harm. A stricter reader could call the two null primaries plus unchanged saliva flow (the mouse's own functional readout) contra. Leniolisib was not dosed in the mouse.
